goal: Build independently reviewed field-condition tune and frozen evaluation sets for class 10 and class 13 before the second calibration.

class_10.name: Mirid bugs (Miridae)
class_10.source: ScienceDB weak-class detection dataset already isolated on the training server

class_13_candidates.name: GHCID
class_13_candidates.quality: Expert annotated; all images inspected at least twice
class_13_candidates.license: CC BY 4.0 for the article and included materials unless separately credited
class_13_candidates.reason: The 31.2 GB folder plus extraction would exceed the safe margin on the 50 GB training volume, and selective public WebDAV access is disabled.

class_13_candidates.name: Roboflow grasshopper-qpkes-i1pbc v1
class_13_candidates.reason: Small enough for the server and already has fixed valid/test splits, but download requires a free Roboflow account login.

required_gates: Map every grasshopper box to official class 13 and independently review the mapping
Compute exact and perceptual hashes against official train/validation and public class-10 data
Keep valid and test splits frozen and never use them for detector or classifier training
Tune only on the 102-image tune set and accept only if the untouched 88-image evaluation and official validation both pass
